follow-up time: Duration of first stage of labor
exposure: Labor onset (spontaneous [augmented and not augmented] vs. induced)
Actual infant birthweight (LGA vs. appropriate-for-gestational age)
Pre-gestational diabetes or gestational diabetes status
labor onset (spontaneous [augmented and not augmented] and induced labor)
Maternal body mass index (obese ≥30 kg/m2 vs. not obese <30 kg/m2)
outcome: Duration of first stage of labor after 3-cm cervical dilation
cohort: Patients admitted for labor from 2004-2014 with a term vertex singleton who achieved 10-cm cervical dilation
finding: Women with LGA infants had a longer first stage of labor after 3-cm cervical dilation compared to those with appropriate-for-gestational age infants, with the difference being most pronounced in nulliparous and obese women.
birth_weight: >90th percentile for gestational age (LGA) vs. 10-90th percentile for gestational age (appropriate-for-gestational age)
